verdict.rationale: Speechmatics documents a dedicated Realtime transcription WebSocket API (wss://global.rt.speechmatics.com/v2/), with auto-routing to the nearest region, temporary keys for client-side auth, and per-session config such as custom dictionary and domain models. This is backed by product positioning for converting streaming audio to text in real time. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the live streaming experience, and evidence of the message protocol details (partial vs. final transcript events, latency figures).
